roles_en: Commander-in-chief of the Republic of Armenia
bio_am: Ծնած է Թիֆլիս՝ 1855-ին։ Հայկական Կորպուսի հրամանատար եւ Հայաստանի Հանրապետութեան միակ սպարապետը, մահացած է Թիֆլիս՝ 1931-ին։
bio_en: Tovmas Nazarbekian was born in Tiflis on 4 August 1855, graduated from the Alexandrovsky military school and, as an officer of the Erivan regiment, served at the siege of Ardahan in the Russo-Turkish war of 1877-78. In summer 1914 he was recalled and commanded the 2nd Caucasian Rifle Division on the Persian front, where he helped defeat Enver's offensive in 1915. When the Armenian National Council formed the Armenian Corps he was appointed its commander, and he became the first and only commander-in-chief (sparapet) of the Republic of Armenia. After Sovietisation he was imprisoned and died alone in Tiflis on 19 February 1931 at the age of 76.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Regular army general, not an ARF member; included as commander of the Republic's army. Story by S. Vratsian, Droshak May 1931.
